mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before a bathroom electrical upgrade project can begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a bathroom electrical upgrade project begins, several preparations are typically helpful. You should define your vision for the space, including desired fixtures, outlet locations, and any new appliances you plan to add. Consider what features are most important, such as dimmable lighting, heated floors, or smart mirrors. Gathering inspiration images can also help. Frasheski Construction recommends having a clear understanding of your functional and aesthetic goals. This allows us to accurately plan the scope, select appropriate materials, and streamline the design process during our initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by defining your vision, desired fixtures, and appliance needs. This helps clarify project scope, material selection, and design during the initial consultation.
